visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman dressed as a breakfast shop employee in a white cap, grey t-shirt, and blue apron stands behind a counter. Behind her is a large red and white menu board with Chinese characters and photos of food. The lighting is bright and even. She smiles widely and gestures with her hands while holding a pair of metal tongs. (2) A second woman, wearing a white collared school uniform, enters the frame from the right. She looks up at the menu board thoughtfully, touching her ear. The background remains the breakfast shop interior with yellow tables and chairs visible. (3) The first woman (shop owner) is seen in a medium shot, shaking her head and laughing. A graphic of a bottle appears as she holds it up towards the camera. The setting shifts briefly to a cooking station where flames rise from a pan while she handles the tongs. (4) The woman in the school uniform receives a plastic bag containing a box of food. She looks at the bag with a surprised expression. Yellow subtitles and variety-style text appear at the bottom. (5) The scene transitions to a close-up of a small dark glass bottle with a dropper. A hand applies a drop of clear liquid to a face. The woman is then shown applying the product to her cheeks and forehead in a bright indoor setting. (6) A final scene shows a woman in a white blazer sitting in a minimalist studio with a white background. She holds the product bottle and speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with her other hand. A logo for 'Pattis' is visible at the end.
